name: Fragments
tagline: A second brain for video: clip, tag and organize the exact moments of online videos that inspire you.

awards: Amazon: AWS Campus Champions - Best Use of DynamoDB Streams
Cohere: Best Use of Cohere API

problem: Creators learn from moments buried in long videos and lose them.
solution: A Chrome extension records and submits clips; AI generates tags and instructions, and a library organizes the saved fragments, on a cloud stack with change streams.
demo_moment: Team-described: clip a moment from a tutorial and find it later with AI tags.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Amazon: AWS Campus Champions - Best Use of DynamoDB Streams” and “Cohere: Best Use of Cohere API” among 261 submissions.
Frames consumption as the input to better creation.

lessons: Two sponsor prizes can come from one product that uses both platforms at its core.
